_meta.description: Comprehensive dataset covering caloric intake, food waste, agricultural output, food prices, organic markets, food delivery, restaurants, fast food, veganism, food security, obesity, malnutrition, vitamin deficiency, diet-related disease, supplements, popular diets, sugar consumption, processed food, water consumption, alcohol consumption, food industry employment, restaurant failure rates, ghost kitchens, meal kits, and street food markets. Sources: FAO, WHO, OECD, EIU, World Bank, Statista, USDA, Euromonitor.
